turns.learner: Hi! Can we learn there is and there are today?

Yes! Can you name one thing in your house?

Example: "There is one sofa. There are two sofas."
Rule: use there is for one thing and there are for more than one.
Right: "There are four lamps."
Wrong: "There is four lamps."

Now you try. Write the missing word:
"___ two beds in the house."
